summary: This 10-day personalized Seoul itinerary guides foreign tourists through the historical charm of Jongno and Insadong, the multicultural vibrancy of Itaewon, the youthful energy of Hongdae, the trendy industrial-chic of Seongsu, and the modern luxury and K-POP pulse of Gangnam, balancing history, shopping, food, and activities.

days.theme: Historic Palaces, Traditional Culture, and K-Pop in Jongno

pois.name: K-pop Shop by CC
pois.address: South Korea, Seoul, Jongno District, Jahamun-ro, 31 크레이브센터 1F
pois.notes: Start your day with a K-POP shopping experience near the palace. This spot offers a variety of idol merchandise, perfect for K-POP fans to find unique souvenirs.

pois.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace (경복궁)
pois.notes: Immerse yourself in Korean history at Seoul's largest and most beautiful palace. Don't miss the changing of the guard ceremony (check times) and consider renting a hanbok for memorable photos.

pois.name: Gwanghwamun Square (광화문)
pois.notes: Walk through this grand public space featuring statues of King Sejong the Great and Admiral Yi Sun-sin, symbolizing Korean heritage and spirit.

pois.name: Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌 한옥마을)
pois.notes: Wander through this traditional Korean village, home to hundreds of hanok (traditional Korean houses). It offers a glimpse into Seoul's 600-year history.

pois.name: The Restaurant
pois.notes: Enjoy a delicious lunch in the scenic Samcheong-dong area, known for its art galleries and cafes. This restaurant offers a great opportunity to recharge before more exploration.

pois.name: Samcheong-dong (삼청동)
pois.notes: Explore the charming streets of Samcheong-dong, known for its unique shops, art galleries, and cafes. It's a great spot for leisurely activity and finding local crafts.

pois.name: Ikseon-dong (익선동)
pois.notes: Discover Ikseon-dong Hanok Village, a blend of traditional hanoks reimagined as trendy cafes, restaurants, and boutiques. Perfect for a cultural and culinary evening.

pois.name: Gwangjang Market (광장시장)
pois.notes: Experience the bustling atmosphere of one of Korea's oldest and largest traditional markets. A must-visit for street food (like bindaetteok) and local goods, offering an authentic 'food' and 'shopping' experience.

days.theme: Art, Culture, and K-Pop Finds in Insadong

pois.name: Jogeum
pois.notes: Enjoy a delicious lunch at Jogeum, a highly-rated restaurant in Insadong, offering a taste of local cuisine in a charming setting.

pois.name: theSameE Insa
pois.address: South Korea, Seoul, Jongno District, Gwanhun-dong, 인사동길 49
pois.notes: Another excellent spot for K-POP enthusiasts to browse and purchase official merchandise and albums, enriching your K-POP 'shopping' experience.

pois.name: Anyoung Insadong Shopping Mall
pois.address: 49 Insadong-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
pois.notes: Begin your exploration of Insadong at this modern complex blending with traditional aesthetics. It houses various shops, cafes, and cultural spaces, including K-POP stores.

pois.name: Ktown4u Insa
pois.address: 49 3F Insadong-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
pois.notes: A haven for K-POP fans, located within Anyoung Insadong. Find a wide selection of albums, merchandise, and fan items to satisfy your K-POP desires.

pois.name: Music Complex Seoul
pois.address: 49 Insadong-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
pois.notes: Dive deeper into the K-POP world with a visit to this music complex, offering more K-POP related items and experiences.

pois.name: Insadong Ssamziegil (인사동 쌈지길)
pois.notes: This unique spiral shopping complex offers traditional Korean crafts, art, and fashion. It's an 'activity' in itself to explore its four floors.

pois.name: Insa-dong (인사동)
pois.notes: Stroll down the main street of Insadong, famous for its traditional tea houses, antique shops, art galleries, and street performances. Perfect for 'shopping' and experiencing 'local culture'.

days.theme: Panoramic Views, History, and Global Flavors in Itaewon

pois.name: Namsan Cable Car / N Seoul Tower (남산 케이블카 / N서울타워)
pois.notes: Start your day with breathtaking panoramic views of Seoul from N Seoul Tower, accessed via the Namsan Cable Car. A great 'activity' for sightseeing and photos.

pois.name: The War Memorial of Korea (전쟁기념관)
pois.notes: Gain insight into Korea's military history and conflicts at this comprehensive museum. An important 'history' and 'cultural' experience.

pois.name: Itaewon (이태원)
pois.notes: Wander through Itaewon's main street, known for its unique shops, tailor services, and foreign goods. It's a great spot for 'shopping' and experiencing a diverse side of Seoul.

pois.name: Gyeongnidan-gil (경리단길)
pois.notes: Discover the trendy Gyeongnidan-gil street, famous for its independent cafes, restaurants, and unique shops. A perfect spot for a leisurely 'activity' and 'shopping'.

pois.name: Taco Amigo
pois.notes: Enjoy dinner at Taco Amigo, a highly-rated restaurant offering delicious Mexican cuisine, perfectly fitting Itaewon's international 'food' scene.

pois.name: Itaewon World Food Street
pois.address: 119-6 Itaewon-dong, Yongsan District, Seoul, South Korea
pois.notes: Explore a diverse range of international cuisines, perfect for lunch. This street embodies Itaewon's multicultural 'food' scene.

pois.name: CAFE TAPE
pois.address: South Korea, Seoul, Yongsan District, Itaewon-dong, 63-5, 2층
pois.notes: Take a break at CAFE TAPE, a popular cafe with a unique, artistic vibe often frequented by K-POP fans, offering a relaxing 'cafe' experience.

days.estimated_cost: 80,000-120,000 KRW (includes N Seoul Tower, food, shopping)

transit_legs.from_name: Namsan Cable Car / N Seoul Tower (남산 케이블카 / N서울타워)

days.theme: Youthful Vibes, Indie Culture, and K-Pop in Hongdae & Mangwon

pois.name: Mangwon Hangang Park (한강시민공원 망원지구 (망원한강공원))
pois.notes: Begin your day with a relaxing stroll or bike ride along the Han River. This 'park' offers a peaceful escape and local 'activity' by the water.

pois.name: Seoul Battleship Park (서울함공원)
pois.notes: Explore decommissioned naval vessels, including a real battleship, offering a unique and educational 'activity' right on the Han River.

pois.name: Mangwon Market (망원시장)
pois.notes: Immerse yourself in a lively local market experience. Perfect for trying traditional Korean street 'food' and finding unique local goods for 'shopping'.

pois.name: Hongdae (Hongik University Street) (홍대)
pois.notes: Dive into the vibrant, youthful atmosphere of Hongdae, renowned for its street art, indie music, fashion boutiques, and street performances. An excellent spot for 'shopping' and 'activity'.

pois.name: K-POP SQUARE Hongdae
pois.notes: A must-visit for K-POP fans, offering a wide range of albums, merchandise, and fan-related 'shopping' items to celebrate your favorite idols.

pois.name: Shanti Restaurant (Hongdae)
pois.notes: Enjoy a satisfying lunch at this highly-rated restaurant in Hongdae, offering a diverse menu that caters to various tastes.

pois.name: AK PLAZA Hongdae
pois.notes: Explore this modern shopping complex for fashion, cosmetics, and various lifestyle goods. It's a convenient 'shopping' destination near Hongik University.

pois.name: Gyeongui Line Forest Park (Yeontral Park) (경의선숲길(연트럴파크))
pois.notes: Enjoy a leisurely walk along this urban park, often called 'Yeontral Park' due to its resemblance to NYC's Central Park. A perfect spot for a relaxing 'activity' and people-watching.

days.theme: Trendy Cafes, K-Pop Culture, and Urban Nature in Seongsu

pois.name: Seoul Forest (서울숲)
pois.notes: Start your day with a refreshing visit to Seoul Forest, a large urban park perfect for a relaxing 'activity' and connecting with nature in the city.

pois.name: KWANGYA
pois.notes: Visit KWANGYA, an immersive K-POP space related to SM Entertainment, offering fan experiences and merchandise. A highlight for K-POP enthusiasts.

pois.name: Seongsu Yeonmujang-gil (성수연무장길)
pois.notes: Explore this trendy street known for its unique shops, ateliers, and cafes housed in converted factories. Great for 'shopping' and soaking in the local atmosphere.

pois.name: Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley (성수동 갈비골목)
pois.notes: Savor authentic Korean BBQ at Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley, a popular spot for locals. This is a fantastic 'food' experience.

pois.name: Jayeondo Sogeumppang (Salt Bread) in Seongsu
pois.notes: Conclude your day with a visit to this popular spot for delicious salt bread, a trendy 'food' item in Seoul. Great for a snack or dessert.

pois.name: Seongsu Handmade Shoes Street (성수동 수제화 거리)
pois.address: Handmade Shoes Street, Seongsu-dong 2-ga, Seongdong-gu, Seoul
pois.notes: Discover the craftsmanship of Seongsu's handmade shoe industry. You can find unique and high-quality footwear, perfect for unique 'shopping'.

pois.name: Amore Seongsu (아모레 성수)
pois.notes: Explore this flagship store and experience space by Amorepacific, offering beauty product trials and unique cosmetic 'shopping' experiences.

transit_legs.to_name: Seongsu Handmade Shoes Street (성수동 수제화 거리)

transit_legs.from_name: Seongsu Handmade Shoes Street (성수동 수제화 거리)

days.theme: Modern Temples, Mega Malls, and K-Pop in Gangnam (COEX Area)

pois.name: CoCo Ichibanya
pois.notes: Enjoy a casual and delicious lunch at CoCo Ichibanya, a popular Japanese curry chain, offering a satisfying 'food' option within or near the COEX complex.

pois.name: Bongeunsa Temple (봉은사)
pois.notes: Start your Gangnam journey with a serene visit to Bongeunsa Temple, a peaceful oasis amidst the bustling city. A profound 'history' and cultural 'activity'.

pois.name: Starfield Coex Mall (코엑스몰)
pois.notes: Immerse yourself in one of Asia's largest underground shopping malls. A vast 'shopping' paradise with diverse stores, entertainment, and eateries.

pois.name: Starfield Library (별마당도서관)
pois.notes: Discover the iconic Starfield Library within COEX Mall, known for its towering bookshelves and impressive architecture. A popular 'tourist_spot' and 'activity' for photos and relaxation.

pois.name: COEX Aquarium (코엑스 아쿠아리움)
pois.notes: Explore the diverse marine life at COEX Aquarium, a fun and educational 'activity' for all ages, located within the mall.

pois.name: K-POP Square
pois.address: 513 Yeongdong-daero, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
pois.notes: Experience K-POP culture at this square near COEX, often featuring large media art displays and K-POP related 'activity'.

pois.name: Cheongdam Bridge (청담대교)
pois.notes: Conclude your day with a scenic view of the Han River and city lights from Cheongdam Bridge, a peaceful 'tourist_spot'.

days.theme: K-Pop Stardom and Trendy Streets in Apgujeong & Sinsa

pois.name: Viaone
pois.address: 11, Yeongdong-daero 82-gil B2FL, 강남구 서울특별시 South Korea
pois.notes: Discover more K-POP merchandise and fan items at Viaone, adding another 'kpop_landmark' to your itinerary.

pois.name: I Have a Dream
pois.address: KG 타워 B1, 7 Teheran-ro 5-gil, Gangnam District
pois.notes: Enjoy a delightful lunch at 'I Have a Dream', a well-regarded restaurant in the heart of Gangnam, offering a pleasant 'food' experience.

pois.name: Mein
pois.notes: Explore Mein for unique fashion and lifestyle items. This 'shopping_mall' offers a curated selection of trendy goods, fitting Gangnam's upscale style.

pois.name: K-Star Road (K-STAR로드)
pois.notes: Embark on a K-POP fan pilgrimage along K-Star Road, famous for its 'GangnamDol' bear art installations representing K-POP groups. A prime 'kpop_landmark' and 'activity'.

pois.name: Dosan Park (도산공원)
pois.notes: Find a tranquil escape at Dosan Park, a beautiful green space dedicated to independence activist Dosan Ahn Chang-ho. A relaxing 'activity' amidst urban bustle.

pois.name: Sinsa-dong Garosu-gil Road (신사동 가로수길)
pois.notes: Stroll along the fashionable Garosu-gil, lined with ginkgo trees, designer boutiques, and chic cafes. Ideal for 'shopping' and people-watching.

pois.name: Banpo Bridge Moonlight Rainbow Fountain (반포한강공원)
pois.notes: Witness the spectacular Banpo Bridge Moonlight Rainbow Fountain show in the evening (check seasonal schedules). A magical 'tourist_spot' and relaxing 'activity'.

days.theme: Royal Tombs and Underground Shopping in Gangnam

pois.name: Seolleung and Jeongneung Royal Tombs (선릉과 정릉)
pois.notes: Explore these UNESCO World Heritage-listed royal tombs, offering a tranquil historical 'activity' and a serene contrast to Gangnam's modernity.

pois.name: 노들강
pois.notes: Have dinner at 노들강, a popular local restaurant offering authentic Korean dishes, providing a delicious 'food' experience to end your day.

pois.name: Artbox Gangnam
pois.address: 42 Teheran-ro 1-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
pois.notes: Browse unique stationery, gifts, and lifestyle products at Artbox. It's a fun 'shopping' stop for souvenirs and cute items.

pois.name: Gangnam Station (강남역)
pois.notes: Dive into the vibrant shopping scene around Gangnam Station, including its extensive underground shopping mall. Perfect for fashion, cosmetics, and various 'shopping' needs.

pois.name: Bonjuk Bibimbap Cafe Gangnam station
pois.notes: Enjoy a traditional Korean lunch at Bonjuk Bibimbap Cafe near Gangnam Station, known for its healthy and delicious 'food' options.

pois.name: Ohmuraan
pois.notes: As an alternative or extra snack/cafe, Ohmuraan is another highly-rated restaurant in the Gangnam area. (Not counted towards the 5-8 POI limit, just an optional mention if less time is spent elsewhere).

pois.name: SCARLET
pois.notes: Continue your 'shopping' spree at SCARLET, a modern shopping destination offering a variety of goods and brands.

transit_legs.from_name: Seolleung and Jeongneung Royal Tombs (선릉과 정릉)

days.theme: Fashion, K-Pop, and Urban Green Spaces in Gangnam (Revisited)
Final Reflections: Culture, K-Pop, and Last-Minute Finds in Gangnam

pois.name: Coex Mall (코엑스몰)
pois.notes: Enjoy last-minute 'shopping' and souvenir hunting at the vast Coex Mall, ensuring you find all the gifts and items you desire.
